notes.title: Roll on Over: Update 13.2.0 is Here!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey, Ballers![/h3]

I’m excited to share some updates to make your Being Ball adventure even better:

[list]
[*] Bobot Arrives Sooner! You’ll now unlock Bobot in the 4th level instead of later in the game. To make this possible, I’ve shuffled the level order and redesigned key areas. Now you can roll with Bobot earlier and enjoy the enhanced gameplay he brings!
[*] Rewind Ready! The rewind ability can now be unlocked in Level 2-1, giving you a second chance to correct those tricky moments. It’s time to roll smarter, not harder.
[*] Fixes That Matter!
[list]
[*] No more accidental Bobot surprises - he’ll only join you at the right moment.
[*] Abilities will stay unlocked once you earn them. Smooth and steady rolling ahead!
[/list]
[/list]
I’ve worked hard on these changes to ensure the game feels more balanced and fun.
This update has been carefully crafted to keep your adventure rolling in the best way possible.
Whether you’re rediscovering old levels or trying out the new flow, I hope you enjoy this update!
So grab Bobot, hit rewind, and explore the new flow!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41476484/b3da4a03b9bff9d9d02f5d9b8a907ce750e18953.png[/img]
As always, I'm eager to hear your thoughts. Share your feedback, and keep rollin’!

notes.title: Accumulated Update November 2024
notes.notes:
[h1]New Features[/h1]

[h2]Cutscene Transitions[/h2]
Introducing a new transition animation between scenes during cutscenes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41476484/b1ef6d56377f8436978e8ff4a50adb610eb30699.gif[/img]

[h2]Free Look Camera[/h2]
A modern way to look around the game world!
Don’t worry—classic mechanics like rotating the view left or right are still available. You can choose your preferred option in the settings.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41476484/17b9fe0e8260dd62a6a198ed322a1786b5e6d319.gif[/img]

[h2]Loading Screen[/h2]
Say hello to a fancy and adorable new loading screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41476484/0a828bd1be25073651f1b637ffa9cdb0b4956dff.png[/img]

[h2]Rewind Ability[/h2]
Bobot now has the power to rewind the ball's position!
This ability can save the ball from falling, provided you have enough energy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41476484/55f73cb27f02b2295f13e3ee74c344c0ecd2026b.gif[/img]
[table noborder=1]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41476484/198efc638078fc2249723e85bb0c674e99d81bb8.gif[/img][/td]
        [td]This ability isn’t available in the current game version but will be included in a future update![/td]
    [/tr]
[/table] 

[h1]Additional Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased energy consumption for the glide ability. 😈
[*] The game now automatically loads into the first or last played level on launch.
[*] Menu background scenes have been permanently removed.
[*] The game engine has been upgraded to Unity 6. This is a significant update, so expect potential issues. Please report any bugs you encounter!
[*] Major updates to core mechanics, improving performance and behavior across the game.
[*] The new rewind ability required changes to key mappings and behaviors. Be sure to review the key mappings page in the settings.
[*] Ground detection has been improved to fix edge cases where “almost wall” surfaces were incorrectly treated as ground.
[/list]


[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where in-game prompts wouldn’t reappear after accessing the menus.
[*] Fixed teleporters ignoring holdable objects, which caused strange behaviors.
[*] Fixed an error occurring when objects scheduled for destruction entered a teleporter.
[*] Resolved pooling issues with water splashes and ripples.
[*] Fixed a potential issue with the rendering order of UI elements.
[*] Fixed the menu appearing when using action keys meant for prompts.
[*] Corrected a shader issue that caused the loading screen spinner animation to freeze.
[/list]

[h1]Big Update, Big Changes![/h1]
This update marks a significant step forward for the game! While I’ve worked hard to smooth out any rough edges, there’s always a chance that a sneaky bug or two slipped through (maybe I planted them, who knows? 👀). Fixing bugs is my top priority, so if you spot any, please don’t hesitate to report them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41476484/b3da4a03b9bff9d9d02f5d9b8a907ce750e18953.png[/img]
And as always... [b]keep rolling![/b]

notes.title: Update Notes for Oct 22
notes.notes:
[h3]So the holidays are gone and updates are back![/h3]

This month's update brings a new level for you to test.
As you can tell from the latest levels, some things aren't done, like decorations, vegetation and in some places some pickups missing.
This is to make level development a bit faster leaving all those missing elements to the fine tuning and tweaking at the end.
I hope you enjoy! please report any issue, here or at the Discord channel.


[h3]Additions[/h3]
Level 2-5 is now available for you to test. Please provide feedback, any feedback..

[h3]Changes[/h3]
Added a “forgiveness threshold” to the jump ability to allow the ball to jump up to ~200ms after it leaves the ground.
Changes to lasers to make them look better when they reflect a surface.

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
Fixed shield ability’s pickup still spawns after subsequent plays of level 2-4, even if you have already picked it up and finished the level.
Added a workaround to Unity’s known issue (which they simply won’t fix) for the water shader that causes wrong lighting and shadows.
Fixed ripples not being rendered correctly.

[*] Fixed shield ability’s chest consumed prematurely, causing the ability’s pickup to never spawn, thus not possible to get the actual ability.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes Sep 22
notes.notes:
[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a duplicate protection for key rebinding. You can now swap keys when prompted.

[*] Level 2-4 is out. You can now unlock the shield ability!
[/list]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Game will try to calculate the best UI scale based on the screen height upon first launch.
[*] Level locked condition changed to include new levels when all previous levels are completed.
[*] Added a progress bar in prompts.
[*] Added a 10 seconds timeout when rebinding a key.
[*] Changed the keys in key rebinding pages to user friendly fancy icons.
[*] Big overhaul to the hints & prompts system.
[*] Big overhaul to the on screen key binding glyphs.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Settings will now load earlier to let new UI changes take effect prior menus show up.
[*] Fixed a script issue causing some of the pickups to not spawn at all.
[*] Fixed a script error causing low framerate on levels with spikes and ball presence detector overlapping trigger area.
[*] Removed the “center of mass” calculation performed on buoyancy objects that produced wrong center points. This causes the ball to “fall aside” imitating floating behavior.
[/list]

notes.title: Upcoming Big Update

Greetings everyone!
[h3]I am keen to inform you about new content that is about to be released in Being Ball in the next coming month in form of a new companion.[/h3]

[list]

[*] Fixed unexpected water splashes from a grass clamp and one bush at the beginning or level 1-4.

[*] Fixed some light objects that won’t take world curvature into account.

notes.title: Update Notes for Feb 2022
notes.notes:
[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] First level cutscenes can now be skipped.
[*] Separated environment from menu scene to ease development.
[*] Game will now slowly pause until complete halt. Before that, it was still running slowly in the background indefinitely.
[*] Changes to the Savegame. Please make sure not to skip this update as it will change your savegame files structure and [b]please report any issues[/b] loading your savegame!
[*] Buoyancy script optimizations.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the last level details won’t be saved when finishing the level.
[*] Fixed potentially wrong details presented in level buttons.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing subsequent cutscenes from showing.
[*] Fixed initial cutscenes won’t start as blank screen causing picking the level before it starts in some rare occasions.
[*] Fixed ball won’t reset after falling to the water before activating any checkpoint in the first level, causing the game to be stuck at looking at the water indefinitely.
[*] Fixed a minor issue where levels start before all objects are done loading.
[/list]

[h2]Please Note[/h2]
Dropping Linux & Android development for now to speed up core game development.
